newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank lowers term reverse repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank lowers term reverse repo rates.

text.p: The Central Bank on Thursday closed its overnight borrowing facility and lowered its borrowing rates on term reverse repos.
Dealers said this gave a cue to the market the Central Bank will further drop its 10 percent overnight borrowing rate.
The Central Bank said it closed its overnight borrowing facility early in the day because it has already squared off and has little borrowing requirements.
The Central Bank is currently offering five-day, one-month and two-month reverse repos which all carry a rate of 10 percent.
It used to sell the one-month and two-month term reverse repos at rates of 10.0625 and 10.125 percent respectively, while the five-day reverse repo is a new offering.
A dealer said the Central Bank's action was intended to make banks more liquid and lead them to shift to the other reverse repos.
